# Step - date_part

`date_part` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

One field as a number (PostgreSQL extract).

## Forms

```text
date_part(arg1: DT)
date_part(arg1: DT, arg2: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(date("2023-08-17")).date_part(DT.day_of_week).next()   // 4
```
